description: Phase 10: Cloud Sync preparation - Song library API models, desktop sync service interface, download workflow models. These are interface/model definitions that prepare for future cloud integration without implementing the actual cloud backend.
steps: Create WorshipPlayer.Core/Models/Cloud/SongLibraryItem.cs: Model for a song in the cloud library. Fields: Id, Title, Artist, Key, Bpm, Tags, CcliNumber, HasBacktracks, HasLyrics, ThumbnailUrl, CreatedAt, UpdatedAt, Version.
Create WorshipPlayer.Core/Models/Cloud/SyncStatus.cs: Enum (UpToDate, LocalChanges, RemoteChanges, Conflict, Downloading, Uploading). Also SyncInfo class with: LastSyncTime, Status, ConflictDetails.
Create WorshipPlayer.Core/Models/Cloud/DownloadRequest.cs: Model for requesting song downloads. Fields: SongId, IncludeBacktracks (bool), IncludeLyrics (bool), IncludeChordChart (bool), TargetFolder.

Create WorshipPlayer.Core/Models/Cloud/ServicePlanDto.cs: DTO for cloud service plans (maps to ServiceOrder). Fields: Id, Name, Date, ServiceType, Items (list of ServicePlanItemDto with SongId, KeyShift, TempoPercent, Notes, CustomSlides).

Create WorshipPlayer.Core/Services/Cloud/ISongLibraryApi.cs interface: SearchSongs(query, filters), GetSong(id), GetSongVersions(id), DownloadSong(request), UploadSong(song), CheckForUpdates(localSongs).
Create WorshipPlayer.Core/Services/Cloud/ISyncService.cs interface: SyncAll(), SyncSong(songId), GetSyncStatus(), ResolveConflict(songId, resolution), SetAutoSync(enabled).
Create WorshipPlayer.Core/Services/Cloud/IServicePlanApi.cs interface: GetUpcomingPlans(), GetPlan(id), SyncPlan(planId), CreatePlan(dto), UpdatePlan(dto).

Create WorshipPlayer.Core/Services/Cloud/DesktopSyncService.cs: Stub implementation of ISyncService that tracks local state, detects which songs have been modified since last sync, and provides the sync workflow (check -> download -> merge -> confirm). Does not make actual HTTP calls (no backend yet), but has the full workflow logic stubbed.
Write unit tests for DesktopSyncService stub: verify sync status tracking, conflict detection logic, download request construction.
acceptance_criteria: All Cloud model classes compile and have proper JSON serialization attributes
ISongLibraryApi, ISyncService, IServicePlanApi interfaces defined with full method signatures
DesktopSyncService implements ISyncService with stub logic
Unit tests verify sync status tracking and conflict detection
findings: All Cloud models, interfaces, and DesktopSyncService implemented in WorshipPlayer.Core (net8.0). 17 new tests added covering sync tracking, conflict resolution, auto-sync preference, progress events, and JSON serialization round-trips for all models. Total test count now 233 (all passing). Build succeeds with 0 errors.
